product_one_liner.value: interface.ai provides an agentic AI platform that automates customer and employee interactions across voice and digital channels for community banks and credit unions.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes its agentic AI platform as built for community banks and credit unions.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no public pricing link; pricing information is handled through contact/demo conversations.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear as customers in dedicated company case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 193 employees, which is within the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn company profile identifies San Francisco, California as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents marketing, banking-AI and product content, with no qualifying set of at least two engineering-authored posts about product construction.

public_docs.notes: The public homepage links to its Knowledge Center as ebooks, guides and strategy resources, but no public product documentation, help center or developer portal is exposed.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Ashby job board lists an open Applied AI Engineer position.

model_provider.notes: The public materials and searches reviewed did not disclose a model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The compliance page names SOC 2 (including Type II) and ISO 27001:2022; only certifications from the requested set are listed here.

last_funding.notes: The October 2024 round was reported as $30 million; Crunchbase classifies it as Series A.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified outside round was announced in October 2024, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open job board lists roles such as Applied AI Engineer and engineering/security positions, but no SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced Nexus, its agentic contact-center platform, on April 14, 2026, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Steve Swanston was appointed Chief Revenue Officer on October 27, 2025, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is explicitly named on the company integrations page; no other CRM or sales/marketing system is included.
